scoring_justification: Cannot recompute from raw atomic configurations; we compare Σ13 energies to paper gold (result-level) and perform structural audit on the energy‑misorientation curve (convex shape + peak location).

hidden_assets.purpose: Paper-reported gold energies for Σ13 and structural expectations for the energy‑misorientation curve.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text: 'predicted grain boundary energy ... 0.96 J·m^−2' and 'computed grain boundary energy ... 0.84 J·m^−2'.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from paper abstract and results section.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are directly taken from the paper's reported numbers; structural requirements (convex curve, peak at 45°) are described in the paper.

outputs.description: Predicted most-stable rigid-body translation and pre-/post-relaxation energies for Σ13[001]/(230). Subject to hidden gold comparison and self-consistency check.
Pre-relaxation and relaxed grain-boundary energies vs misorientation angle for all 13 unseen boundaries. Used to verify the energy-versus-misorientation profile.

output_contract.notes: The agent must implement the full pipeline from atomic configurations to SVR training and predictions. The checker will validate the JSON and CSV formats and perform structural and hidden reference checks as appropriate.
